entries.description: An intensive residential courses and retreats center offering workshops, internships, and retreats for women, located on 10 acres of land with housing, permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, bio-dynamic garden, and women living and working on the land.
entries.raw_text: HARDSCRABBLE HILL CENTER Box 130-Castine Rd, Orland, ME 04472 (207)469-7112. From Spring to Fall our intensive residential courses and retreats for women expand the heart, challenge thinking, and offer practical tools and experience. We welcome: new members/residents, workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices, staff, private retreatants, artists in residence. We welcome all wild women, whatever stage or age on the feminist journey, creating new names as we go. We have: 10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity in some buildings, camping space, woods, bio-dynamic garden, women living and working' the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it runs intensive residential courses and retreats as its main purpose. Accepted groups is empty because it invites 'all wild women' without specifying non-lesbians. Focuses includes Workshops/education ('intensive residential courses and retreats... workshop participants... internships-apprentices') and Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('bio-dynamic garden'). Land address copied from rural route/road address.

entries.description: A small family of 2 lesbians and 2 girl children on 30 acres of land with housing, electricity, a well, outhouse, camping space, and woods. Cleared trails for hiking and picnicking. Welcomes campers, girl children (boys by invitation only), non-lesbian women, and dogs. Has a rule against smoking, drinking, and drugs.
entries.raw_text: LINDA TISDALE/CAROL SHOREBORN RFD 2 Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172. We are a small family of 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 1 dog, 4 cats, 1 horse (soon to be more). We've cleared trails for hiking, picnics, camping, etc. Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present. We currently have no housing for other lesbian visitors but we welcome campers. Must be able to hike to campsite carry all needs in and out! Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians. We do not smoke, drink, use drugs. We welcome: girl children (boys by invitation only), nonlesbian women, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 30 acres of land, housing/permanent structures, electricity, well water, outhouse, camping space, woods, women living and workin' on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('family of 2 lesbians'). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred from community presence), Girl children ('girl children'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), and Boy children ('boys by invitation only'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('We do not smoke, drink, use drugs'). Acreage: 30. Residents: 2 adults (plus 2 children). Land address copied from RFD mailing address.

entries.description: Additional information for a listing, offering retreat and healing space primarily in the form of primitive camping on nearly 143 acres. Features a sauna in progress and two ponds for swimming. Work is welcomed and chemicals are discouraged.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805. This is additional info to our listing in VI,2. We can offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping - $2 to $5 a day if you can. Our accessibility is unfortunately poor (143 acres almost all uphill.) We'll probably have a visitor' kitchen so please bring your own food, the sauna is in progress and both ponds are fine for swimming. Work is welcomed. Chemicals are discouraged.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it offers 'retreat and healing space'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred as a lesbian directory listing offering space). Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Chemicals are discouraged'). Acreage: 143. Land address copied from rural route address.

entries.description: A homesteader/farmer/carpenter living on 20 acres with cows, chickens, bees, fruit trees, and a garden. Not a separatist and requires work exchange for visits (limited to 2-3 days). Features a house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, and pasture, with a strict substance-free rule.
entries.raw_text: ONEIDA FARM RD 5, Dillsburg, PA 17019 (717)432-2157. (Between Harrisburg and Gettysburg.) I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden. I am not a separatist and cannot accomodate flag-waving, breast-baring sisters. Visits (limited to 2-3 days) require work exchange. No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns. Visitors are expected to bring own food, etc. Non-lesbian women welcome. I prefer that you telephone so that we get to know each other before we set up a visit. I have a house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, pasture.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule (written in first person singular 'I am a homesteader', single resident implied). Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred), Non-lesbian women ('Non-lesbian women welcome'). Focuses: Farming/self-sufficiency ('homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows... garden') and Recovery/substance-free ('No drugs, cigarettes'). Acreage: 20. Land address copied from rural route address.

entries.description: A women's community and retreat center on 35 acres in a land trust, home to 4 lesbians with a feminist perspective. Features 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, and camping/indoor space. Developing a retreat center and supporting local businesses like a landscaping company and printing shop. Welcomes visitors and new members of all colors and persuasions, and children.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE WOMENS COMMUNITY 21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-1070. We are a new wom'ns community/retreat center, 35 miles north of Baltimore. We have/are: 4 lesbians with a feminist perspective, support for political involvement, strong ties with Baltimore wom'ns community, 35 acres of woods, meadow, stream in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space. We are developing the retreat center (facilities for up to 50) as a business to support the place and members. Local jobs are possible with wom'n landscaping company, wom'ns printing shop. Long and short term commitment. We welcome: visitors, new members, all women of all colours and persuasions, girl and boy children. It's a wonderful place and we want to share it!
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it is an established community of 4 lesbians with shared living, land trust property, and recruiting members. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred), Non-lesbian women ('all women of all colours and persuasions'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'). Focuses: Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('wood and solar heat', 'organic gardens'), Workshops/education ('developing the retreat center... facilities for up to 50'), Archives/cultural work ('wom'ns printing shop'). Acreage: 35. Residents: 4. Land address copied from street address.

entries.community_name: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET
entries.land_location_as_stated: Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA
entries.description: Property owned by Nan and Ruth featuring 20 acres with a passive solar shell built this summer. Currently working away from land but aiming for small-scale farming and farm animals. Welcomes non-lesbian wimmin, children, males, and dogs. Has a strict substance-free rule against drugs, tobacco, and heavy drinking.
entries.raw_text: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET c/o Nan and Ruth, PO Box 63, Unger, WV 25447 (304)258-5079. (Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.) We own 20 acres on which we built a passive solar shell this summer with the help of friends. We have to work away from the land at this point, but one of us is trying to find local work to be able to be more in touch with the land (small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal). We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers. We welcome: non-lesbian wimmin, girl & boy children (parental supervision a must), males, medium to small dogs (females only, please). Bring food to share. No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, housing & permanent structures, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, a male dog (does not get along with other male dogs), wimmin living (full time) and working (part time) on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('2 lesbians', owned by Nan and Ruth). Contact name is Nan and Ruth. Land city is Unger from mailing address, land street address left blank due to PO box. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred), Non-lesbian women ('non-lesbian wimmin'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl & boy children'), Gay men and Non-gay men ('males'). Focuses: Recovery/substance-free ('No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers') and Farming/self-sufficiency ('small-scale farming and a few farm animals'). Acreage: 20. Residents: 2.

entries.description: 3-5 wimmin living on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio with a house, barn, and another house under construction. Features goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, and farmland. Welcomes wimmin and children to stay up to a week for help with food and work exchange like house remodeling and daily chores.
entries.raw_text: MOON RIDGE Rt 1 Box 240, Guysville, OH 45735. We are 3-5 wimmin on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio. We have a house with electricity and a barn and another house under construction. We have dogs, cats, goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, farmland, wimmin living and working on and off the land. We welcome wimmin and children to stay up to a week for help with food and work exchange (house remodeling - daily survival chores).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it is a group of 3-5 wimmin living and working on the land together. Accepted groups: Lesbian women (inferred) and children ('children' coded as Girl children and Boy children). Acreage: 55. Residents: 3 (taking the lower bound of '3-5 wimmin').
